features.quote: without ever leaving the event site
features.rationale: The text says the hotel becomes the dance venue and attendees can sleep, dance and celebrate there without leaving the event site, so the parties are in the hotel where they stay.

features.quote: workshops open to all skill levels
features.rationale: The workshops are explicitly open to all skill levels, and the text adds that there is a place for beginners.
Dance classes and workshops are described as part of the weekend's programme.
